processDescription: 5-axis CNC milling centers provide simultaneous multi-axis interpolation for complex titanium components. The ability to tilt the tool relative to the workpiece surface maintains optimal chip load and extends tool life, critical for difficult-to-machine titanium alloys, specifically for flange. Precision flange for Aerospace, Chemical, Oil & Gas present unique challenges: Large diameter (up to 600 mm) with bolt hole pattern PCD tolerance ±0.1 mm. Face flatness critical for seal integrity.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-spindle (50–70 bar) with coated carbide tooling. Adaptive trochoidal milling paths reduce radial engagement to control heat generation.
flatnessControl: Face flatness critical for seal integrity. Sequenced bolt-hole drilling pattern (opposite poles) prevents flange warpage.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for CNC machining of flange faces and bolt holes, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
